macros.name: froufrou
macros.doc: After \usepackage{froufrou}, just call \froufrou to create a subdivision. By default, the separator behaves like \section, suppressing indentation in the following paragraph.

macros.name: setfroufrou
macros.doc: You may select a different separator appearance either by supplying the name of a predefined ornament as a package option (\usepackage[ornament]{froufrou}) or by calling \setfroufrou{ornament} anywhere in the document.
